verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS product, and docs-18 confirms it offers an API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence describes an interactive reference or runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec, api.md and llms.txt all returned 404. A bare mention that an API exists does not establish an explorable, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
